name: capacity_limit_multiplier_dock
comment: 该项作用于控制最大尺寸。注意每一级是对上一级做差之后的数字。/ Controls conversion of dockyard by stairs to new logic max tonnage limit. Format as rate1;tonnage1, rate2;tonnage2, … and finally rateN;-1 for rest.

comment: 本土港口吨位对于造船能力的贡献。原始值为0.11。/ Home province port tonnage contribution to shipbuilding capacity. Vanilla to be 0.11.
